notes: Strip is almost all estates, farm tracts, Mill Creek, the B&O SW RR and the canal: no street crossing has its centre inside x 1980-3520. The only crossing within about 300 px of the strip is Lafayette x Middleton (x 3853, Middleton ends at Lafayette); Warren x Middleton (x 3955) is a little further out and is given for the tie. Warren's name is printed 'WARREN ... AVE.'; Middleton is printed 'MIDDLETON AVENUE' south of Warren. The avenue along the bottom edge (centre about y 7010, McAlpin Avenue by the instructions; only 'AVENUE' is printed near here) has no crossing between x 1680 and 3820. A narrow unnamed strip (two lines about 27 px apart, x 2405-2432, y 5120 to 6965, grey boundary band beside it) runs north from the bottom avenue to the McIllvain's subdivision line: read as a lot strip / boundary, not a street, not picked. Spring Grove Avenue crosses only the top-left corner with no crossing on the plate there.
